title: Review carryover (model output of review-carryover)
description: carryover.json, written by the review-carryover agent from the found previous notes (spec 047 ADR-4). The file-level checks that need the stage (read_id, notes = the found previous notes, every source a found previous note, ids unique, the byte cap) are lib/review_digest.py's; the document-level coverage of the ids is lib/review_carried.py's.

read_id.description: The read id the agent was given; must equal the read's.

notes.description: Exactly the found previous notes, one entry each.

items.description: How many items of this file rest on this note.

text.description: The item as it stands now, in the review language.

sources.description: Stems of the previous notes the item rests on.
